input: Need to pick up dry cleaning before Friday.
expected_behavior: Recover the single task as one bullet. Do not split it into multiple bullets or pad with invented related content to reach a higher count.
notes: Draft acceptance case for PROMPT_CONTRACT_VERSION=source-determined-bullets-v1 -- floor case, single supported idea.

input: Call the dentist to reschedule, and separately, remember to water the plants while I'm away.
expected_behavior: Recover exactly two independent bullets -- one per supported idea -- without merging them into one or splitting either into extra bullets.
notes: Draft acceptance case -- two clearly separable ideas, tests neither merge nor split.

input: Three things: renew the car registration, email Sam about the project timeline, and pick a paint color for the hallway.
expected_behavior: Recover exactly three bullets, one per stated item, in any order. No fourth bullet invented, no two items merged into one.
notes: Draft acceptance case -- mid-range count, explicitly enumerated by the note itself.

input: So much going on: the roof needs inspecting, the car needs an oil change, I owe Priya a call back, the gutters are clogged, I still haven't filed the insurance claim, the dog needs a vet visit, I need to return the drill to Marcus, and I never finished setting up the new router.
expected_behavior: Recover at most seven bullets even though eight distinct supported ideas are present -- the cap is a hard ceiling, not a suggestion. Do not merge two ideas into one bullet just to fit under the cap; drop or combine only if genuinely necessary, and never invent a ninth idea.
notes: Draft acceptance case -- ceiling case, 8 source ideas against the 7-line cap. Deliberately adversarial: checks the cap holds without the model silently merging two real ideas into one bullet to dodge the overflow.

input: Worried about the rent going up again. Rent increase is really stressing me out.
expected_behavior: Recover one bullet for the single underlying worry (the rent increase), even though it's stated twice in different words. Do not produce two bullets for what is one restated idea -- that would be padding via repetition, not two supported ideas.
notes: Draft acceptance case -- tests 'never repeat content to reach a target count' specifically, the restatement-as-padding failure mode the no-padding rule was written to prevent.
